name: Genetic inheritance, inherited disorders and sex determination

terms.definition: A different form of the same gene.
terms.examiner: Some characteristics are controlled by one gene; most by several.

terms.definition: An allele that is always expressed, even if only one copy is present.
An allele that is only expressed if two copies are present.
terms.examiner: Shown with a lower case letter.

terms.definition: Having two identical alleles of a gene.
The alleles an organism has, such as Bb.
terms.examiner: Phenotype is the characteristic shown, such as brown eyes.

terms.definition: Having extra fingers or toes; caused by a dominant allele.
terms.examiner: One parent with the allele can pass it on.

terms.definition: A disorder of cell membranes caused by a recessive allele.
terms.examiner: Both parents must carry the allele for a child to have it.

terms.definition: One of the 23 pairs: females are XX, males are XY.
terms.examiner: A Punnett square shows a 50% chance of each sex.
